newsitem.title: USA: PECO seeks broad test base for power wheeling.
newsitem.headline: PECO seeks broad test base for power wheeling.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said the retail wheeling pilot proposal it filed with the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission calls for a neutral third party will randomly select customers from across all rate classes.

The third party will also select a political subdivision in Philadelphia and one township or borough in the suburbs from a pool of eligible localities. All residential customers in the two selected localities will be eligible for the pilot.
The third party will also select commercial and industrial customers, using a total of 75 megawatts of electricity, from Enterprise Zones in the City and suburbs.
